title: Utility Constructs: Scanner, Grabber, Repair Arm, Beacon, Civilian Bubble
description:
Purpose: Provide non-combat utility constructs deployable via the wheel: Scanner Drone, Grabber Hand, Repair Tool Arm, Searchlight Beacon, and a short-duration Shield Bubble for civilians.

Controls (Quest 3 — verbatim):
- Activation via selection wheel then Right Trigger.
- Left Grip can guide drones; Left Trigger toggles drone scan pulse.
- B Button: Dismiss currently active utility construct (if applicable).

Params (params_json):
- scanner_scan_interval_s (float, default 2.0)
- scanner_range_m (float, default 18.0)
- grabber_pull_force (float, default 35.0)
- repair_progress_rate (float, default 0.25) per second
- beacon_light_intensity (float, default 1.0)
- civilian_bubble_duration_s (float, default 8.0)
- civilian_bubble_hp (float, default 50.0)

Behaviour:
1) Scanner Drone (construct_scanner_drone):
   - Spawns a hovering drone that periodically emits a scan pulse (Left Trigger toggles). Marks enemies/objectives through limited cover with ring_hud_ui_pack markers. Left Grip gently tugs drone position for guidance.
2) Grabber Hand (construct_grabber_hand):
   - Spawns a hand that can latch onto small debris/items and pull them toward player or target anchor. Applies elastic tether visuals back to the ring.
3) Repair Tool Arm (construct_repair_tool_arm):
   - When aimed at repairable panels/doors, start a channel; progress accumulates at repair_progress_rate; on completion, fire event to open door (satisfies test_repair_tool_function).
4) Searchlight Beacon (construct_beacon_searchlight):
   - Deployable light source with a rotating head; improves visibility and reduces enemy ambush effectiveness within a cone (AI perception modifier).
5) Civilian Shield Bubble:
   - Temporary protective bubble around a tagged civilian; absorbs damage up to civilian_bubble_hp and lasts civilian_bubble_duration_s (satisfies test_civilian_bubble_escort).

Components:
- Reads: targeting from construct core, CTransform, CTag (repairable, civilian), AI perception interfaces.
- Writes: spawned construct entities, HUD markers, repair progress UI, shield bubble HP component.

Comfort/safety:
- All manipulations are world-stable; no forced camera motions.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_scanner_marks_targets, test_repair_tool_function, test_beacon_light_dark_area, test_civilian_bubble_escort.

Integration:
- Registers under Utility category of promoted.ring_construct_core.
- Drains ring energy from promoted.ring_charge_and_recharge per construct usage.

Scenes:
- derelict_space_station, civilian_rescue_zone.

Suggested file split: utility_constructs_register.cpp, utility_scanner.cpp, utility_grabber.cpp, utility_repair.cpp, utility_beacon.cpp, utility_bubble.cpp.
